look_here_first: Start with the head: curlytop gumweed is typically rayless, with only yellow disc florets surrounded by many narrow spreading to ascending resin-gland-tipped phyllaries. Vegetative parts are strongly gland-dotted and aromatic.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: glabrous to nearly glabrous gland-dotted shoots

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: many narrow spreading to ascending phyllaries with resinous tips

lookalikes.differences: Rayless yellow head + gland-dotted aromatic foliage + narrow spreading resin-tipped phyllaries is the strongest field package.
